_comment: DOCUMENTATION TEMPLATE — NOT CONSUMED AT BUILD TIME. Vercel only reads vercel.json from the project root; it cannot pick a different file per project. This file exists so the intended build-time config for the ceolawyer.ailevel.app Vercel project is checked into source. To apply: in the ceolawyer Vercel project, copy the `buildCommand`, `installCommand`, `outputDirectory`, `framework`, `regions`, and `headers` from `vercel.json`, then set the env vars below in Project Settings → Environment Variables (Production + Preview). See docs/runbooks/ceolawyer-vercel-deploy.md for the full procedure.
